summary: 24 commits between 1f252c9 and b2397f8 plus this comms close-out. Five legible arcs: (1) iOS polish + Netlify reliability — modal-off-center fix, !important specificity correction, Netlify prebuild script, Nostr live indicator. (2) Operator-laziness gap closing — QR paste fallback + iPhone-PWA detection, paper-K_data export+import end-to-end, 5e-vii library half + 5 tests, WalletGuide tabs + OpenTimestamps credit, text-readability bump. (3) Tier V depth + sovereignty framing — tappable presence cards with full PresenceDetailModal, Sovereignty tab + Settings preamble, journal-attachment integrity verify, sovereign-confirm step on cloud-backup-off, QR Pick-a-photo + 5e-vii self-signed auto-emit. (4) Key rotation + identity polish — UX prune of crypto name-drops, RotateKeySection, IdentityCard genesis-vs-active fix, rotation resilience cut 1 (auto-rebuild Mycelium subscription), Fresh young-adult brief, IdentityCeremony Bind-Face-ID step, handshake-flow names audit. (5) Presence anchor live status — useAnchorStatus wiring so the just-anchored state surfaces honestly instead of stale 'not yet anchored.'

why.text: Operator's Socratic Q&A mode tipping into rapid-cut execution. Each turn surfaced a real gap (UI bug, copy gap, missing surface) by reading the actual running wallet on iPhone PWA. The cuts collectively moved the wallet from 'spec-complete through 5e-v with blended transport' to 'a wallet a real operator can use day-to-day without hitting show-stoppers.' The math was already correct; the surface met the math halfway across this arc.

5 new wallet tests added in d0bfdef (createRecoverySuccession M-of-N math). 48 wallet tests total. tapit-attest unchanged at 154 (150 pass + 4 skipped network).
outcome.tests_passing: wallet 48/48 (5 new this arc — Phase 5e-vii library); tapit-attest 154 (150+4 skipped network, unchanged). typecheck + lint + build green at every commit.
outcome.notes: [P-001] iOS UX (zoom prevention, off-center modal fix, readability bump) shipped via global CSS at !important specificity to beat Tailwind class selectors. [P-002] Netlify deploys unblocked via package.json prebuild that runs tapit-attest's tsc before the wallet's. [P-003] Phase 5e-v cohort recovery now fully end-to-end (library + ceremony UI + blended transport + paper-K_data fallback + self-signed succession auto-emit + IdentityCeremony Face-ID bind + rotation UI with auto-resubscribe). [P-004] Phase 5e-vii peer-witnessed succession: library shipped (createRecoverySuccession.ts + tests), self-signed half auto-emits on recovery, peer co-sign UI deferred to fresh session. [P-005] Sovereignty spectrum (Connected / Connected-private / Sovereign-with-cohort / Sovereign-solo) named in WalletGuide + Settings preamble + opt-out responsibility-confirm. [P-006] UX prune dropped Schnorr/secp256k1/Merkle name-drops from user-facing copy; kept where they do real explanation work. [P-007] Handshake-flow audit closed two real pubkey-leak surfaces via peerNamesByPubkey helper + handshake-specific EnvelopePreview render. [P-008] Live-anchor-status wiring fixed the 'not yet anchored' misread on freshly-captured presence events. [P-009] Fresh young-adult theme brief filed at project-memory/.../briefs/2026-05-24-fresh-young-adult-theme-roadmap.md — nine-cut Carpenter-ready spec. [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: 24-commit arcs without intermediate comms close-out make the eventual aggregation heavier than needed. Aggregate every 3-5 cuts even in rapid-iteration mode.

uncertainty: Every cut is gate-green and tested at the layer it was cut at; aggregated cross-cut behavior would benefit from a real-device walk now that the surfaces are in place. The biggest open risks for the next session: cohort-peer NIP-44 behavior on key rotation (the rotation UI warns about it; mechanical proof still pending), and the cohort-shares-stale-on-rotation gap which rotation resilience cuts 2-3 would close.
ripple: Phase 5e-v fully end-to-end on the wallet side — every recovery seam shipped + automated. Operator field-test ready.
Phase 5e-vii — math + self-signed half landed; peer co-sign UI remains.
Sovereignty spectrum surfaced + opt-out friction in place + Fresh roadmap queued.
Key rotation operational including the cohort warning + auto-resubscribe + identity-card honesty.
Bundle/file-size discipline holding at the edges; flagged for proactive extraction in handoff.
